subject.title: fix: network error hardening, session short-id entropy, extension load caching

question: Should this protected PR land as one coordinated runtime-hardening change after final lifecycle review, or should the extension-cache work be split from the network and session-ID fixes?
rationale: The branch deliberately groups three independent, central runtime surfaces; whether their shared release/review scope is desirable is a maintainer ownership decision rather than a mechanical defect determination.

options.title: Review and land together
options.body: Keep the coordinated hardening change intact after confirming reload-cache lifecycle semantics and the stated runtime proof.

options.title: Split the cache change
options.body: Land the network and session-ID fixes separately if extension-module cache lifecycle needs more focused review or ownership discussion.
